# KaTeX

KaTeX 0.16.47 (https://katex.org, MIT licence, see `LICENSE`), taken unchanged from the npm package `katex@0.16.47` (`dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/katex.min.css`, the `woff2` fonts of `dist/fonts`). Only the woff2 fonts are included; the style sheet also names woff and ttf files as fallbacks, which current browsers never request.

It sets all formulas of the page. The server hands out exactly these files under `/vendor/katex/`.
